raw.details:
Line-O-Mania is a robotics contest where teams build autonomous robot capable of following a pre-defined path on a contrast background. The track will be black and white and include challenges such as bends, loop, sharp turns, junctions, dotted lines, and dead-ends. The bots will require precise navigation to reach the end point in the shortest possible time. In addition, a special element will be introduced in the track, which will be disclosed only on the day of the event, adding an extra layer of challenge and unpredictibility.

Team Formation Rules:

  • One participant cannot be in more than one team. 
  • Each team must have a unique team name. 
  • No restriction on the number of teams from a college. 
  • Inter-college teams are allowed. 
  • Only one member selected by the team will be allowed to perform hand touch to the bot (if required) 
  • Each team must appoint a Team Leader (all communication via leader). 
  • Team Leader must be present during the run.

Track Specifications:

  • Track layout will be disclosed on the spot. 
  • Line: 3cm wide on black and white contrast track. 
  • Start and end points will be different.
  • Track material: Flex sheets made of PVC

Bot Specifications:

  • Robots must be completely autonomous, no remote controlled bots allowed. 
  • Pre-run inspection will be conducted. 
  • No pneumatics, hydraulics, or harmful mechanisms allowed. 
  • No pre-made kits or Lego kits permitted.
  • Maximum DC voltage ≤ 12V between any two circuit points. 
  • If the bot malfunctions, a short repair timeout of 30 secs can be opted for. Runtime will resume after 30 seconds or whenever the team is ready.

Conduction Rules:

  • Damaging the arena will lead to instant disqualification.
  • If the bot leaves the track or requires intervention → restart from the previous checkpoint. Only Five (5) such penalties are allowed. After the 5th penalty the bot will get disqualified.
  • 1 minute allowed for sensor calibration before run; timer starts regardless after this.
  • Violation of rules may lead to disqualification. 
  • The judge's decision will be final and binding. 
  • Misbehaviour will lead to immediate disqualification.

Judging & Scoring:

  • Scoring System: (600 - Time taken in seconds) - (Penalties + Skips)
  • Bonus points for completing the track.
  • Skipped checkpoints = time penalty
  • Maximum 2 figures/obstacles can be skipped; beyond that, all figures/obstacles have to be cleared or the team may choose to end their run.
  • If the bot exits the arena, the team will have to restart from their last checkpoint with a penalty.

Note: Rules may be subject to change according to the circumstances
